rule.source: version 2.1: notes/design/04_v2_spec.md sections 1 (Q14), 7 (R1), 8 (R12, R13) and 11 (R26, 2026-11-17), adopting draft 04_v2_spec_draft.md section 7 (S-1 to S-4); version 1's rule (build spec B12 as amended) is replaced; R12's quota rule replaces "the first six admitted" (Q14 and S-3's last sentence); R26 doubles every quota of R12 (twelve scored buildings instead of six; the rule as fixed in build/v2/final/pool.md, rule 1, before the pool run) and keeps row 3's time part as the absolute bound it meant (1200 s); version 2.0's rule is in git history (commit 40c2da2c)
rule.candidates: k = 1..48 (two cycles of the table by candidate number, S-2) with seed_k = int.from_bytes(sha256(b"quadruped_hazardous_plant_inspection/hidden/v2/<k>").digest()[:8], "big") >> 1; practice candidates use the label .../practice/v2/<k>, the documents batch .../doctest/v2/<k>, so the sets are disjoint by construction; version 1's seeds, sites and practice buildings are not reused
rule.order: each candidate is put through the admission rows on its own; one is admitted when all of these hold

rows.1: it generates within 64 sub-seeds with every required row (version 1's rows as changed by L1-13, L2-9 and L3-6, with the new ones: plate_readable, tags, sheet_items, sheet_rules, sheet_nothing_drawn, sheet_edges, outline_walls, drawing_fails_missing, approach_flat, B-low_back)
rows.2: the frozen reference, run once exactly as the grader runs the oracle, delivers a report with accepted evidence for all ten items, read each of the eight plates as its tag before reporting (in its log), ends upright on the pad, and scores S of at least 0.80
rows.3: the reference uses at most 1200 s of simulated time (R26: an absolute bound, what 50 % of version 2.0's 2400 s limit meant), 50 % of the dose rating and 60 % of each frame budget
rows.4: on that site: idle, walk-out-and-back, last-logged-values and constant-values score 0.00, and corridor-only scores at most 0.10

rule.set: R12, the quota rule, with every quota doubled by R26: going through the admitted candidates in k order, a candidate joins the set unless it would be the seventh with its bund kerb class, the seventh with its B-step variant, the seventh with its B-low variant, or the fifth with its sheet place; the set is complete at twelve (their k order is the episode order h01..h12). Quotas give six of each kerb class and of each B variant and four of each sheet place by construction, without choosing by hand; the order is k, so no tie arises

quota.read_from: the generator's record of the candidate as built (bund, b_step_variant, b_low_variant, sheet_place); each is checked against the table's row for k (tables.table), a difference is recorded with the candidate and the as-built value counts

rule.exclusion: R12: the exclusion list stays as measured (two entries, sketch/site/config/exclusion_v2.json, sha256 3413ac3b...), with the pass rate taken over every layout that reached the slot's placement stage; the sub-seed cap stays (64); the list and the table are written into selection.json before any seed of the hidden label is generated

notes.R13: Admission row 3 stays, and the lean it gives is accepted: a site where the reference uses more than half of the dose rating or of the time is not scored (a strong source on the corridor every route passes: 2 of 13 and 1 of 5 development sites in wave 2). The reference stays time-optimal; no dose-aware planner. Reason: the half is the headroom an unprivileged program needs; version 1 made the same choice (spec 04_v2_spec.md section 8, R13)
notes.R26: Version 2.1 (spec 04_v2_spec.md section 11, 2026-11-17): twelve scored buildings, by R12's rule with every quota doubled, and a tighter simulated-time limit for every mission, scored and practice alike (the training hall keeps its 900 s; the value is R27's). Row 3 keeps its absolute bound for time, 1200 s of simulated time (what "at most 50 % of 2400 s" meant), with 50 % of the dose rating and 60 % of each frame budget as before, so the admitted candidates are the same by construction; the admission is run again under the changed configuration and must reproduce every final state. The practice rule F-1, the label, the k range, the tables and the exclusion list are unchanged

rule.record: every candidate's result is recorded, also the dropped ones, with a hollowing check (features of the twelve against all candidates: the table's columns, the number of instruments on the missing sheet and the as-built way of C-sealed among them)
rule.if_short: if fewer than twelve join the set, stop and report: do not change the rule
rule.practice: F-1 (S-4): practice candidates k = 1..12 of .../practice/v2/<k> with the same table; one qualifies when row 1 holds and the frozen reference (run as the grader runs the oracle) delivers all ten items with accepted evidence and scores 0.80 or more; t1, t2, t3 are the first triple i < j < l, in the order (i, j, l), of qualifying candidates whose buildings together show both bund classes, both B-step variants, both B-low variants, three different places of the missing sheet and every deviation class; the candidates passed over are recorded

how_the_rows_are_read.1: the generator's candidate record: generated, proofs_ok (every required row in memory), no failed_rows, and recheck_from_files.required_ok where the record has a recheck, for the package whose sha256 the record names (a record for other bytes fails the row)
how_the_rows_are_read.2: one mission of the oracle submission (solution/reference/patrol.py: one frame of every sensor, then reference_run) on a privileged PlantCellServer(config=tests/grader_config.json, mode='hidden', reference_dir=tests/reference) reset(package, seed=seed_k, kind='hidden') over cellkit.wire with tests/verify.py's caps, in the image's ENV and tests/test.sh's exports; a mission in which the cell failed (internal error, physics fault, lost frame) is run once more and the second run counts (verify.py _episode_with_retry). Every item delivered; each instrument's report cites a frame that meets its evidence condition (E = 1); the mark's dwell condition and the source's approach condition hold (E = 1); R = 1.0 (upright within 1.0 m of the pad centre, no fall, no dose limit); S >= 0.80; the reference's own log (reference_log.json of the counted attempt) holds, for each of the eight instruments, a plate read whose text equals the tag no later than the item's report
how_the_rows_are_read.3: from the same mission: sim_time_s <= 1200 s (R26: absolute, whatever the mission's limit; the record also gives the share of the mission's limit); dose_fraction <= 0.50; for each frame budget of tests/grader_config.json (nav, inspect, depth, thermal, lidar) frames used <= 0.60 x the budget
how_the_rows_are_read.4: one mission of each of tests/review/baselines.py's submissions (unprivileged, the same seed and the same way as row 2); 'score 0.00' = an S that rounds to 0.00 at two decimals (S < 0.005); corridor_only S <= 0.10

tables.type_rule: slot i gets TYPE_ORDER[(i + k + floor((k - 1) / 8)) mod 8] (TYPE_ORDER ['gauge_63', 'gauge_100', 'gauge_160', 'level', 'valve_lever', 'valve_handwheel', 'lamps', 'thermal'], slots ['A', 'B-step', 'B-kerb', 'B-low', 'C-sealed', 'C-moved', 'C-relocated', 'C-annex']); then, in that slot order, a slot whose (slot, its variant, the sheet's place where it matters, type) is on the exclusion list swaps its type with the type of the first later slot (wrapping round) for which neither slot is then on the list (ruling R1)

exclusion_measured.label: dev-sitegen2b-rates/v2/<j>
exclusion_measured.design: job j: S-2 column (j-1) % 8, place ((j-1) // 8) % 3, type offset ((j-1) // 24) % 8 (slot i -> TYPE_ORDER[(i + offset) % 8], no repair), sub-seed 0; every slot's placement stage run (a failed slot left unplaced, the next one tried); n = layouts that reached the placement; rate_reached = among those whose earlier slots passed

tables.exclusion_rule: R1 (04_v2_spec.md section 7): the (slot, the slot's variant, the sheet's place where it matters, type) pairs that pass their placement stage on fewer than one sub-seed in five, measured on at least 20 sub-seeds of a development label; place '*' = every place (listed by place only where the rate over every place is not below 1/5 but the rate at that place is)

exclusion.rule: R1 (04_v2_spec.md section 7): the (slot, the slot's variant, the sheet's place where it matters, type) pairs that pass their placement stage on fewer than one sub-seed in five, measured on at least 20 sub-seeds of a development label; place '*' = every place (listed by place only where the rate over every place is not below 1/5 but the rate at that place is)

measured.label: dev-sitegen2b-rates/v2/<j>
measured.design: job j: S-2 column (j-1) % 8, place ((j-1) // 8) % 3, type offset ((j-1) // 24) % 8 (slot i -> TYPE_ORDER[(i + offset) % 8], no repair), sub-seed 0; every slot's placement stage run (a failed slot left unplaced, the next one tried); n = layouts that reached the placement; rate_reached = among those whose earlier slots passed
